harness_note: Each case is an invocation of TrustEngine::evaluate_with_measurement at the pinned source. The declared measurement travels inside the signed request; the observed measurement is supplied by the caller, standing in for the enforcement point.

cases.name: attested matching measurement is allowed
cases.rationale: The control that distinguishes a correct denial suite from an engine that denies everything.

cases.name: stolen key with a self-declared matching measurement, no observation
cases.request_signature: valid, generated key (the attacker holds the key)
cases.rationale: A caller-supplied claim about its own workload must never satisfy the binding, even when it matches the registered value and is correctly signed.

cases.name: stolen key, observation contradicts the declaration
cases.request_signature: valid, generated key (the attacker holds the key)
cases.rationale: The observed measurement overrides what the request claims.
